subject: NorthStar — Dedicated GPU pool onboarding: ops sprint & peak-burst policy
messages:
From: Carly Zhang <carly.zhang@northstar.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@northstar.ai>
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity — initial requirements

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We want to move forward with Redwood Dedicated for our inference infrastructure for NorthStar Labs. Key asks from our side:
- Primary region: US-West (us-west-2) with failover to US-East (us-east-1)
- Expected steady throughput: ~110 req/s at 2k token avg, with daily peaks that could hit 3x for 15–30 minutes
- Need a burst policy for training-inference overlap windows (10–20 min bursts)
- Data residency + KMS requirements (we use AWS KMS)

Can we schedule a short ops sprint next week to finalize pool sizing and autoscale/burst defaults? Also attaching our internal capacity spreadsheet.

Thanks,
Carly
NorthStar AI — Head of Platform

5) KMS + audit-log handoff items

Naomi / team,

Prework notes before the sprint:
- I reviewed NorthStar's spreadsheet. For 110 req/s at 2k tokens avg, baseline (per-model) estimate: 8 x A100-80GB equiv per pool for steady traffic with room for autoscale to 24 GPUs for sustained + transient peaks.
- Burst policy we typically recommend: allow short-duration bursts to up to 1.8x the autoscaled max for 10 min with a 15 min cooldown, or a focused "burst queue" with capped token budget.
- Regional plan: primary pool in us-west-2, secondary cold-standby in us-east-1 (auto-failover with warm-up pre-warming hooks).
- Action items for sprint: draft SOW redlines, confirm KMS ARN format, collect sample traffic traces (if available).

I'll attach a condensed capacity estimate and a mutual action plan to send to NorthStar pre-sprint.

- Prio

Wed 2026-07-01 11:00 PDT works for us. A couple clarifications before the call:

See you on Wednesday — Carly

From: naomi.feldman@redwood.ai <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Carly Zhang <carly.zhang@northstar.ai>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: NorthStar — ops sprint follow-up: mutual action items

Thanks everyone for the sprint — notes and agreed next steps below. (Condensed for clarity.)

Decisions made:
- Pool topology: primary single-pool in us-west-2 (8 baseline A100 equiv), autoscale floor 8 -> ceiling 24 GPUs.
- Burst policy: allow a transient burst to 36 GPUs for up to 12 minutes with token-budget guardrails; automated cooldown of 18 minutes. This matches NorthStar's nightly scoring profile while capping exposure.
- Cold standby: us-east-1 with automated failover and a pre-warm hook (3 GPUs warm) to speed recovery.
- KMS: Customer-managed AWS KMS accepted; we need ARN + role for grant.

Action items (owner / ETA):
- NorthStar: provide KMS ARN, 2-week traces (Carly) — due 2026-07-03.
- Redwood (Prio): deliver final capacity-estimate PDF and MUTUAL ACTION PLAN v1 (today EOD).
- Redwood (Marcus): prepare pool provisioning ticket and estimated lead time for reserved capacity (2–3 weeks typical).
- Procurement (Ben): Redwood will share SOW draft for review (Naomi).

I've attached the mutual action plan and the capacity estimate. Please confirm the burst window + cooldown feel acceptable. If no objections by EOD Friday we'll wrap the SOW and start provisioning prep.

Best,
Naomi
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
